runNotes: The runner script (tools/playtest/ashfall_qa.py) was stopped by the host for low system memory shortly after launch; the player kept running and completed the probe. The report summary and MP4 encoding were done afterwards from the player output.

From the missions-panel step on, the virtual keyboard and gamepad stopped reaching the game while the simulation kept running (no exceptions logged). This matches the Input System default of resetting/disabling devices when the window loses focus; other applications were in use on the machine. Failures caused by it: missions-panel, map-panel, gamepad-melee-kills-zombie, juggernaut-drawn-large (the survivor could not turn to face it), gamepad-throws-grenade and vehicle-enter. Fixed in 7f06838: the probe sets InputSettings.backgroundBehavior to IgnoreFocus.
talk-to-enclave: the probe placed the leader on open ground outside the radio station, out of talk range, so the dialog closed itself. Fixed in 7f06838.
raiders-attack-on-sight: raiders only engaged within 12 m and the leader stood 14 m away. Raiders and hunters now engage at 22 m with a gun (7f06838).
Night lighting measured at ambient 0.08 was too dark to read; raised in 0df2200.
notProven: A clean rerun of this probe after the fixes in 7f06838 and 0df2200
Physical controller hardware (the probe uses a virtual gamepad device)
Human playtime, balance and pacing over multi-hour sessions; the legacy (all hearts destroyed) outcome in normal play
Freak, raider, airdrop, red-zone and plague-heart scenes were staged by the probe (spawned or scheduled next to the leader and kept alive); natural encounter rates are not measured
